title: SERIOUS DATA PRIVACY CONCERN — PHONEPE NEEDS TO INVESTIGATE
text:
I have been using PhonePe for my personal transactions, and I am extremely concerned about a serious privacy issue that has come to my attention.

While dealing with a loan recovery issue involving Zypee, their representatives appear to have information about my PhonePe transactions and the people I made payments to. They have contacted people connected to me—including my friends’ sisters, my sisters, colleagues and family friends—regarding my loan and requested that they make the payment.

What is extremely concerning is that the people being contacted are individuals to whom I had previously made payments through PhonePe. Zypee appears to have knowledge of these transactions and access to contact information connected with them.

This raises a very serious question:

How could a third party know which people I had made payments to through PhonePe while taking the loan?

I have call recordings and call logs documenting these incidents.

I am not making an assumption about the source of the information. However, the apparent connection between my PhonePe transaction history and the third-party contacts being approached is serious enough that PhonePe should investigate whether any customer transaction data, recipient information or associated contact information has been improperly accessed, disclosed or shared.

I expect PhonePe to:

* Investigate whether my transaction data has been accessed by any unauthorised third party.
* Investigate whether my transaction history or recipient information has been shared with Zypee or any other entity.
* Explain how a third party could apparently identify people I had transacted with.
* Review whether any API, lending-partner, data-sharing or third-party integration could have exposed this information.
* Preserve and investigate the relevant access and audit logs.
* Provide me with a proper explanation rather than a generic customer-support response.

PhonePe transactions contain extremely sensitive information about people’s financial activities and relationships. Customers should be able to trust that this information remains private and is not being used to facilitate third-party harassment or loan recovery.

I am raising this review because I believe this deserves a serious data-privacy investigation, not merely a routine support ticket.

PhonePe — please investigate this matter urgently and explain how this information could have reached Zypee.
